It also sanitizes the desktop file by removing the AppImage-specific version key and installs icons, metadata, and the license. All operations are confined to standard packaging practices.

No network requests, dynamic downloads, or execution of fetched code occur during build or install. There is no obfuscation, suspicious command usage (e.g., curl|bash), or data exfiltration. The package merely repackages a verified AppImage into a standard Arch Linux package format. While the use of prebuilt binaries limits transparency, the sources are pinned to a specific version and checksummed, which is common for -bin packages. No evidence of malicious behavior is present.
</details>
